messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
**All‑time Premier League Assist Leader**

| Player | Club(s) | Seasons Played | Total Assists |
|--------|---------|-----------------|---------------|
| **Ryan Giggs** | Manchester United | 1995–2008 | **162** |

*Ryan Giggs remains the single‑player record holder for the highest number of assists ever recorded in the English Premier League.*  
He achieved those 162 assists over his entire career with Manchester United, spanning more than a decade of consistent creative output.  

Other notable names near the top include:

| Rank | Player | Total Assists |
|------|--------|--------------|
| 2    | Paul Scholes | 140 |
| 3    | Steven Gerrard | 139 |
| 4    | Frank Lampard | 138 |
| 5    | David Shearer | 137 |

These figures reflect cumulative statistics across all Premier League seasons up through the end of the 2023/24 campaign.
